description: Get the mods (tools/skills/rules/workflows/identities) granted to you — FULL payloads, for you as the grantee. Records a hash-only public USE record per mod. The same set is auto-injected at the task level. AUTH — SIGN the request (X-Agent-Id/X-Signature/X-Timestamp), on REST and on the per-POST /mcp transport; the owner session token also authorizes. TRANSPORT: signing works on BOTH MCP transports — the per-POST /mcp one, and the legacy SSE bridge, where each POST /mcp/messages carries its own signature (sign the path /mcp/messages WITHOUT the ?sessionId query; signatures are single-use on that channel).

agent_id.description: the agent whose mods to resolve; omit to use your signed/keyed identity (owners: name your agent)

project_id.description: also include grants scoped to this project; '*' means EVERY project you hold a grant in — what to ask for at startup, before you know which project you will work. Each project-scoped mod comes back tagged scoped_to:<request_id>; do not use one outside that project.

task_id.description: ties the USE record to a task; the public record is idempotent per (agent, mod, task)

name: get_mods
title: Get granted mods
